description: A climbing foliage plant with large split leaves. Give it space and a sturdy support; younger leaves may have fewer holes.
sunlightInstructions: Provide bright filtered daylight, sheltered from harsh afternoon sun.
wateringInstructions: Let the upper quarter of the potting mix dry, then water thoroughly and drain. Check less often in winter.
fertilizingInstructions: Feed only during active growth, following a suitable product label; reduce or pause when growth slows. Add and adjust a reminder if needed.
soilInstructions: Use an airy houseplant mix with drainage; never leave the pot standing in water.
humidityInstructions: Prefers humid air and a warm room. Keep away from cold drafts and radiators.

description: A trailing or climbing plant with heart-shaped leaves, often marked with gold. A useful choice for shelves and hanging pots.
sunlightInstructions: Filtered daylight supports good growth. Lower light is tolerated; avoid scorching direct sun.
wateringInstructions: Allow the mix to dry between thorough waterings, and empty the outer pot. Growth slows in winter.
fertilizingInstructions: Feed only during active growth, following a suitable product label; reduce or pause when growth slows. Add and adjust a reminder if needed.
soilInstructions: Use a freely draining indoor potting mix in a pot with drainage holes.
humidityInstructions: Ordinary indoor humidity is tolerated; protect from cold drafts.

description: An upright succulent with stiff, patterned leaves. Also sold under its former name, Sansevieria trifasciata.
sunlightInstructions: A bright position is useful, but it tolerates lower light. Introduce stronger sun gradually.
wateringInstructions: Let the potting mix dry before watering. In winter it may need water only every month or two; check first.
fertilizingInstructions: Feed only during active growth, following a suitable product label; reduce or pause when growth slows. Add and adjust a reminder if needed.
soilInstructions: Use a very well-drained succulent mix and a pot that releases excess water.
humidityInstructions: Tolerates dry room air. Keep out of frost and cold, wet conditions.

description: A slow-growing plant with glossy leaflets and water-storing rhizomes. Too much water is a greater risk than an occasional missed check.
sunlightInstructions: Bright indirect daylight is ideal; lower light is tolerated. Protect from hot direct sun.
wateringInstructions: Water only after the mix dries. Winter checks may be spaced further apart; do not water a still-damp pot.
fertilizingInstructions: Feed only during active growth, following a suitable product label; reduce or pause when growth slows. Add and adjust a reminder if needed.
soilInstructions: Choose a well-drained mix and a container with drainage holes.
humidityInstructions: Ordinary indoor humidity is suitable. Keep in a warm room, away from cold windows.

description: A cascading plant with narrow arching leaves and hanging plantlets. Variegated forms are common indoors.
sunlightInstructions: Choose filtered daylight; keep leaves out of strong direct sun.
wateringInstructions: Keep the mix lightly moist rather than saturated. Let the surface begin to dry and reduce watering in winter.
fertilizingInstructions: Feed only during active growth, following a suitable product label; reduce or pause when growth slows. Add and adjust a reminder if needed.
soilInstructions: Use a moisture-retentive but draining houseplant mix.
humidityInstructions: Average indoor humidity is usually suitable. Keep away from cold drafts.

photo.title: Chlorophytum comosum, Spider Plant, houseplant view

description: An upright indoor tree with thick, glossy leaves. Keep its position stable and handle the irritating milky sap carefully.
sunlightInstructions: Provide bright indirect light, with protection from strong afternoon sun.
wateringInstructions: Check the mix before watering and avoid keeping it continually wet. Water less during slower winter growth.
fertilizingInstructions: Feed only during active growth, following a suitable product label; reduce or pause when growth slows. Add and adjust a reminder if needed.
soilInstructions: Use a draining houseplant mix and empty any water left in the cover pot.
humidityInstructions: Average room humidity suits it. Avoid drafts and sudden temperature changes.

description: A small indoor tree with slender branches and many pointed leaves. Moving it or changing its light abruptly can cause leaf drop.
sunlightInstructions: Choose a bright, stable position with indirect daylight.
wateringInstructions: Water before the entire root ball dries, while allowing excess water to drain. Check less frequently in winter.
fertilizingInstructions: Feed only during active growth, following a suitable product label; reduce or pause when growth slows. Add and adjust a reminder if needed.
soilInstructions: Use a well-drained, moisture-retentive indoor potting mix.
humidityInstructions: Protect from cold drafts, heating vents and sudden changes in conditions.

description: A cane-forming foliage plant with broad strap-shaped leaves. Cultivars may have green, cream or yellow striping.
sunlightInstructions: Moderate to bright filtered light works well; harsh sun can damage leaves.
wateringInstructions: Keep the mix moderately moist during active growth, without leaving it waterlogged. Reduce watering in winter.
fertilizingInstructions: Feed only during active growth, following a suitable product label; reduce or pause when growth slows. Add and adjust a reminder if needed.
soilInstructions: Use a draining indoor potting mix and a pot with drainage holes.
humidityInstructions: Very dry heated air can brown leaf tips. Avoid cold drafts and hot radiators.

photo.title: Dracaena fragrans, Corn Plant, houseplant view

description: A group of houseplants with glossy foliage and white flower-like spathes. This entry gives general guidance for common indoor hybrids.
sunlightInstructions: Use filtered daylight or partial shade; avoid direct sun.
wateringInstructions: Keep the mix evenly moist, not soggy. Check the surface and pot weight rather than watering automatically.
fertilizingInstructions: Feed only during active growth, following a suitable product label; reduce or pause when growth slows. Add and adjust a reminder if needed.
soilInstructions: Use a moisture-retentive houseplant mix that still drains freely.
humidityInstructions: Prefers a warm room with humid air. Keep away from cold drafts.

description: Common flowering orchid hybrids with arching stems and long-lasting blooms. Their exposed roots need air as well as moisture.
sunlightInstructions: Choose bright filtered light, such as a sheltered east-facing window.
wateringInstructions: Run tepid water through the bark and drain completely. Let the bark partly dry; avoid water sitting in the crown.
fertilizingInstructions: Feed only during active growth, following a suitable product label; reduce or pause when growth slows. Add and adjust a reminder if needed.
soilInstructions: Use a bark-based orchid medium, not ordinary dense potting soil.
humidityInstructions: Keep warm with gentle airflow and moderate humidity; avoid cold drafts.

description: A rosette-forming succulent with fleshy, toothed leaves. Keep it ornamental; this catalog is not guidance for eating or applying plant material.
sunlightInstructions: Provide strong daylight with some sun; introduce brighter conditions gradually.
wateringInstructions: Wait for the mix to dry before watering thoroughly and draining. Water much less during winter.
fertilizingInstructions: Feed only during active growth, following a suitable product label; reduce or pause when growth slows. Add and adjust a reminder if needed.
soilInstructions: Use a gritty, fast-draining succulent mix and drainage holes.
humidityInstructions: Dry indoor air is suitable. Protect from frost and cold, wet roots.

description: A branching succulent with rounded, fleshy leaves. Older plants can develop a small tree-like form.
sunlightInstructions: Give it a bright position with some sun, sheltered from very harsh afternoon exposure.
wateringInstructions: Water moderately only when the mix has dried. Reduce watering from autumn through winter.
fertilizingInstructions: Feed only during active growth, following a suitable product label; reduce or pause when growth slows. Add and adjust a reminder if needed.
soilInstructions: Use a freely draining succulent mix; do not leave water in the saucer.
humidityInstructions: Ordinary dry room air is suitable. Keep protected from frost.

photo.title: Form of a 40 year old plant

description: A compact plant with round leaves on long stalks. It often forms small offsets around the parent plant.
sunlightInstructions: Use bright indirect daylight, away from harsh sun and heating vents.
wateringInstructions: Keep the mix lightly moist and well drained; do not keep the roots saturated.
fertilizingInstructions: Feed only during active growth, following a suitable product label; reduce or pause when growth slows. Add and adjust a reminder if needed.
soilInstructions: Use a light, draining houseplant mix in a pot with drainage holes.
humidityInstructions: Average home humidity is tolerated. Avoid cold drafts and direct heat.

description: A clumping indoor palm with arching feathery fronds. Also commonly sold as Dypsis lutescens; it needs room as it grows.
sunlightInstructions: Provide bright indirect daylight in a warm room.
wateringInstructions: Keep the mix moist but not soggy during growth. Check moisture before watering and drain the pot.
fertilizingInstructions: Feed only during active growth, following a suitable product label; reduce or pause when growth slows. Add and adjust a reminder if needed.
soilInstructions: Use a well-drained indoor potting mix and a pot that drains freely.
humidityInstructions: Prefers humid air. Dry heating conditions can be challenging; keep away from radiators.

description: A large foliage plant with broad banana-like leaves. It can outgrow a small room; the reference photo shows a mature flowering plant.
sunlightInstructions: Provide a very bright position with filtered daylight.
wateringInstructions: Water after the top layer of mix dries, then let excess water escape. Adjust checks as growth slows.
fertilizingInstructions: Feed only during active growth, following a suitable product label; reduce or pause when growth slows. Add and adjust a reminder if needed.
soilInstructions: Use a draining, loam-based indoor potting mix in a sturdy pot.
humidityInstructions: Prefers warm, humid conditions. Protect leaves from cold drafts and sudden temperature changes.
